description:
The strategy doc explicitly defers Phase 3 (hosted submission API) until
Phase 2 PR volume justifies the operational cost. It cites indicators
("submission volume exceeds ~50/month sustained", "maintainer review
becomes a sustained bottleneck", etc.) but no one is currently measuring
those indicators, and there is no decision moment where someone is asked
to look.

Without measurement and a forcing function, the Phase 3 promotion
decision will be made by whoever feels frustrated first - which is
exactly the kind of ad-hoc engineering decision the strategy doc is
trying to prevent. This item operationalizes the trigger: pick the
metrics, build the cheapest possible dashboard, and put a review on
someone's calendar.

anti_patterns.dont: pick metrics that can't be measured cheaply
anti_patterns.why: a dashboard nobody can build is the same as no dashboard; favor `gh` CLI queries and a flat notes file over building a metrics service.

anti_patterns.dont: set the thresholds so low that they trip on noise
anti_patterns.why: false promotion of Phase 3 wastes the largest engineering investment in the project.

anti_patterns.dont: start any Phase 3 implementation work as part of this TODO
anti_patterns.why: that defeats the deferral the strategy doc explicitly requires; this is measurement and decision plumbing only.

preserves.behavior: Existing Phase 3 planning TODOs (`design-results-ingest-storage-and-derived-read-model`, `integrate-benchbox-cli-submit-and-service-auth`, `operate-results-platform-security-observability-and-abuse-controls`) remain Not Started until a review explicitly promotes them.
Strategy doc's deferral of Phase 3 - this TODO measures the trigger, doesn't pull it.

verifications.description: Promotion metrics doc exists with concrete thresholds
Metrics script runs and produces a report
verifications.expected: exit 0, markdown output with one section per metric

work_units.notes:
From the strategy doc indicators, choose 4-6 measurable signals.
Suggested starting set:
  - Merged community submissions / month (threshold 50 sustained)
  - Median PR review latency in hours (threshold 72h)
  - PR backlog (open >7 days) (threshold 5 sustained)
  - Requests for private/unlisted results (threshold 3 distinct
    requests)
  - Submissions blocked by maintainer-only constraints (threshold 5)
  - Org-account / team-space requests (threshold 3 distinct)
Document each metric with: query/source, threshold, what it implies
if breached. Save as
`_project/analysis/phase-3-promotion-metrics.md`.
work_units.summary: Pick concrete promotion metrics and thresholds

work_units.notes:
Inputs:
  - GitHub API (PRs against `published-results`, labels, merge dates,
    review timestamps) via `gh` CLI subprocess or PyGithub.
  - Optional: user-feedback file `_project/notes/phase-2-requests.md`
    for the qualitative metrics.
Output: markdown report to stdout (or `--output FILE`), one section
per metric, current value vs threshold, simple Y/N "breached?" flag.
Read-only; no API writes; no auth beyond `gh auth status`.
work_units.summary: Build a minimal `scripts/phase2_metrics.py` that computes the metrics

work_units.notes:
Add to `_project/analysis/phase-3-promotion-metrics.md`:
  - Review cadence: quarterly (first Monday of each quarter).
  - Owner: BenchBox maintainer rotation.
  - Procedure: run `phase2_metrics.py`, paste output to handoff file
    `_project/handoffs/phase-3-review-<date>.md`, decide whether any
    threshold breach justifies promoting
    `design-results-ingest-storage-and-derived-read-model` and
    `integrate-benchbox-cli-submit-and-service-auth` to Active.
Add a calendar reminder (or repo-level reminder issue) for the next
review date. Calendar = source of truth; this TODO doesn't try to
invent a scheduler.
work_units.summary: Schedule a quarterly review and document the promotion procedure

work_units.notes:
Run the script today against the (currently small) Phase 2 dataset
and commit the baseline report to
`_project/handoffs/phase-3-review-baseline-<date>.md`. Even if all
thresholds are far from breached, the baseline shows the trajectory
over time.
work_units.summary: Run the first baseline review and capture the starting state
